annotations.text:
Ledger, with redactions.

Bone paper, ink, hairline rules — a financial document rather than a SaaS page. The product panes are dark instrument surfaces inset into it, so the control room appears inside the document.

Only two colours carry chroma and both are states: green = quiet path, burnt orange = the fingerprinting one.
Both detail artboards are live — the hero widget loops through scan → score → route, and the disclosure tabs switch role. Click into an artboard to drive it.
